author: Ekta Sharma
text:
Extreme scam. At time of ordering delivery date was showing in two weeks. After order was placed, delivery date changed to two months out. Asked to cancel the order since it was past the event timeline. They didn’t reply for 48 hours and said I’ve missed the deadline for cancelling order. 

If you want your peace of mind for a big event, especially if you’re international. DO NOT ORDER from AZA
